content.full_text: Our study programmes Degree programmes Bachelor & Master Advanced Master's programmes Study programmes for international professionals HTW Foundation Study preparation for international applicants Why study at HTW Berlin? Small groups : There are no large lectures at HTW Berlin. Learning takes place in groups with a maximum of 40 students. Practical relevance : Modern laboratories, an internship semester in every bachelor's programme and lecturers with professional experience ensure practical relevance. Lots of support : From maths bridge courses before your studies to career advice after graduation: at HTW Berlin you will receive all-round support. Good infrastructure : WLAN, computer pools and a well-equipped library offer the best study conditions. International campus : Language courses in eight foreign languages, semesters abroad at 150 partner universities and English-language degree programmes open up international perspectives. Application Find out all about admission requirements and application deadlines. We look forward to receiving your application !
